description:
NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price, sole-source, supply-type purchase order to Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) SIMS Pump Valve Company.

See the attached solicitation, posted on 01 May 2026, for requirements. All responses shall be submitted prior to the solicitation closing date of 04 May 2026 at 1:00 p.m.
